purpose: Test generalization limitation before searching stronger constraint targets
primary_hypothesis: With5 subjects and near-perfect training Dice, adding outer-label loss has little optimization headroom. Paired spatial augmentation may improve generalization and reveal whether bands have an additional effect.

design.augmentation: xy_d4_v1, the paired image/label permutation already verified and used by MNI UNETR
design.existing_controls: Archived no-augmentation baseline and10% bands at the samefold/seed
design.base_loss: Keep each established winning model loss exactly unchanged
design.schedule: Keep each established model schedule, matched to each arm cap
design.activation: 10% prefix;10% linear ramp; keep constant thereafter to isolate augmentation
design.checkpoint_selection: Final-budget primary; common-FLOP learning curves secondary; no post-hoc early-stop selection

diagnostics: At10%,20%,50%,100% log train/validation macro and union Dice, FN/FP/internal swaps, band support coverage and training-only actual base/band gradient ratio.
Log base and bands losses separately; current total-loss curves hide which objective saturates.
Same training subjects, sampling, initial seed, augmentation sequence and preprocessing within each pair; calibration uses training only.
Report both augmentation-only gain and incremental bands gain; augmentation helping both is not evidence for bands.
decision: Do not launch3fold3seed confirmation unless a fixed recipe improves final-budget validation without class collapse; development validation is not an unbiased held-out estimate.
secondary_hypothesis: Class-aware boundary supervision addresses internal swaps. The zero-update categorical-gradient probe passes direction checks, but improved validation Dice requires a separate controlled training ablation; do not combine it with augmentation in the first experiment.
authorization_note: No new training was submitted during this investigation. Only zero-update interrupted-checkpoint evaluation ran.
